journal_storage.policy: Retain durable active journals in bounded temporary storage; archive closed files with verified hashes before removing their hot originals.

license_provenance.redistribution: Preserve upstream Freedoom credits/license when distributing the IWAD; do not label the entire engine bundle MIT.

renderer.coordinated_reset: fresh participant processes and isolated episode working directories
renderer.native_barrier: both set_action then shared barrier then advance_action(1); four tics per logical decision

runtime_at_start.scope: observed_development_simulator_stack; not a CUDA/PyTorch training-host validation

selected_iwad.selection: explicit bundled freedoom2.wad; each worker verifies engine path and hash

journal_io_probe.cache_scope: Ordinary filesystem caching remains enabled. Each append requests fsync; no direct-I/O or power-loss test is claimed.
journal_io_probe.interpretation: Measures this small durable-journal workload at the recorded directories. It does not change storage settings, move learning data, reduce fsync frequency, or benchmark the full collector.
journal_io_probe.ordering: location order alternates each repetition; 21721 deterministic PRNG, fresh payload per append
journal_io_probe.timing_scope: Open append stream, write bytes, flush, request os.fsync, and close; warmup, directory creation, verification, cleanup and report writes excluded.

resources.limitation: Sampling can miss very short-lived processes and CPU before a child's first sample; summed RSS can double-count shared pages.
resources.scope: Collection parent and observed descendants, including initialization and teardown.

storage_benchmark.cache_scope: Reader chunk cache disabled to measure decompression; no OS-cache eviction or direct-I/O claim.
storage_benchmark.metadata_scope: Real RGB plus dummy validity/index numeric timing columns. Full privileged/event schema, simulator interaction, concurrent GPU training and durable interaction journaling are outside this codec-only benchmark.
storage_benchmark.resource_scope: This benchmark process and descendants under the recorded logical-CPU budget; original affinity/thread environment restored after timing.

selected.scope: Collection storage headroom on this host; eventual model-loader/GPU consumption has not been benchmarked.
selected.selection_rule: At chunk128 prefer the lowest deflate level saving >=10% vs stored with measured durable write and sequence-read rates each >=2x collection rate; otherwise stored. Other chunk sizes are reported comparators.

source.scope: Bounded real-replay sample used only for codec timing; excludes missing images and does not alter dataset partitions or interaction counts.

storage_benchmark.timing_scope: Production NPZ codec, durable/fsynced writes and uncached decompression per sequence; OS page cache remains warm. PNG decoding/source loading, report writes and equality checks are excluded from write timing; read timing includes per-window equality verification.

read_resources.ram_definition: Sampled sum of per-process RSS; shared pages can be counted more than once. Windows private memory is also reported.
read_resources.scope: Acceptance parent + its descendants only; startup/teardown excluded.
